text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 123 पर युधिष्ठिर की डायरी पढ़ो: सोमवार, शाम 4 बजे से 6 बजे तक क्या-क्या हुआ।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 123 par Yudhishthir ki diary padho: somvaar, shaam 4 baje se 6 baje tak kya-kya hua.
text.en: Read Yudhishthira's diary on page 123 of your book: what happened on Monday from 4 pm to 6 pm.

steps.question: Who was wandering in the forest?

questionMeaning.hi: जंगल में कौन भटक रहा था?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Jungle mein kaun bhatak raha tha?

steps.question: When were the Pandavas wandering in the forest?
At what time did they feel thirsty?
When did Yudhishthira order Nakula to bring water?

questionMeaning.hi: नकुल को पानी लाने को कब कहा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Nakul ko paani laane ko kab kaha?

steps.question: When did Yudhishthira himself go to the pool?

questionMeaning.hi: युधिष्ठिर ख़ुद तालाब पर कब गए?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Yudhishthir khud taalaab par kab gaye?
